questions.text: Match the headings with the short paragraphs about everyday routines.
questions.explanation: 1) A busy start to the day — Абзац описує ранкові справи та поспіх перед виходом. Відповідний фрагмент: Before leaving home, Ella prepares breakfast and checks her timetable. She then cycles to the bus stop to catch the early service. 2) Sharing responsibilities — Розподіл домашніх обов'язків є головною ідеєю. Відповідний фрагмент: Everyone in the flat has a task. One person cooks while the others wash dishes and tidy the common rooms. 3) Finding time to relax — Основна тема — відпочинок після занять. Відповідний фрагмент: After studying, Hugo switches off his phone for an hour. He reads by the window or listens to a podcast. 4) Keeping in touch from a distance — Ідеться про підтримування спілкування попри відстань. Відповідний фрагмент: The cousins live in different cities but call each other every Sunday. They also send photos of important family events.

pairs: A busy start to the day
Before leaving home, Ella prepares breakfast and checks her timetable. She then cycles to the bus stop to catch the early service.
Sharing responsibilities
Everyone in the flat has a task. One person cooks while the others wash dishes and tidy the common rooms.
Finding time to relax
After studying, Hugo switches off his phone for an hour. He reads by the window or listens to a podcast.
Keeping in touch from a distance
The cousins live in different cities but call each other every Sunday. They also send photos of important family events.

questions.text: Match each situation with the most suitable notice.
questions.explanation: 1) You want a small appliance fixed without replacing it. — Оголошення про волонтерський ремонт побутової техніки. Відповідний фрагмент: REPAIR DESK: Bring broken kettles and toasters on Saturdays. Volunteers will examine them free of charge. 2) You need temporary care for a pet while travelling. — Послуга догляду за домашніми тваринами під час відсутності власника. Відповідний фрагмент: PET SITTING: Home visits available for cats and dogs when owners are away. Book at least two days ahead. 3) You have outgrown several jackets but want to exchange them. — Swap означає обмін одягом без купівлі. Відповідний фрагмент: CLOTHES SWAP: Bring clean garments in good condition and choose items in your size. No money involved. 4) You want to borrow tools for a home project. — Це пункт тимчасової видачі інструментів. Відповідний фрагмент: TOOL LIBRARY: Members can take drills and gardening equipment home for up to three days.

pairs: You want a small appliance fixed without replacing it.
REPAIR DESK: Bring broken kettles and toasters on Saturdays. Volunteers will examine them free of charge.
You need temporary care for a pet while travelling.
PET SITTING: Home visits available for cats and dogs when owners are away. Book at least two days ahead.
You have outgrown several jackets but want to exchange them.
CLOTHES SWAP: Bring clean garments in good condition and choose items in your size. No money involved.
You want to borrow tools for a home project.
TOOL LIBRARY: Members can take drills and gardening equipment home for up to three days.

questions.text: Match the relationship adjective with its meaning.
questions.explanation: 1) reliable — Reliable означає надійний, відповідальний за обіцянки. Відповідний фрагмент: Someone who can be trusted to do what they promise. 2) considerate — Considerate — уважний до потреб інших. Відповідний фрагмент: Someone who thinks about other people's feelings and needs. 3) stubborn — Stubborn — впертий і негнучкий. Відповідний фрагмент: Someone who refuses to change their opinion despite good reasons. 4) supportive — Supportive — той, хто підтримує та підбадьорює. Відповідний фрагмент: Someone who offers encouragement during difficult situations.

pairs: reliable
Someone who can be trusted to do what they promise.
considerate
Someone who thinks about other people's feelings and needs.
stubborn
Someone who refuses to change their opinion despite good reasons.
supportive
Someone who offers encouragement during difficult situations.

questions.text: Match the beginning of each statement with the ending.
questions.explanation: 1) Although my brother and I have different hobbies, — Although вводить протиставлення різних інтересів і дружнього спілкування. Відповідний фрагмент: we still enjoy spending weekends together. 2) Before you borrow someone's belongings, — Правило ввічливості в побуті: спершу запитати дозволу. Відповідний фрагмент: make sure you have their permission. 3) If the neighbours make too much noise, — За першої проблеми рекомендується спокійна розмова. Відповідний фрагмент: try speaking to them politely before complaining. 4) When friends disagree about a plan, — Compromise допомагає врегулювати розбіжність. Відповідний фрагмент: they can look for a compromise that suits everyone.

pairs: Although my brother and I have different hobbies,
we still enjoy spending weekends together.
Before you borrow someone's belongings,
make sure you have their permission.
If the neighbours make too much noise,
try speaking to them politely before complaining.
When friends disagree about a plan,
they can look for a compromise that suits everyone.

questions.text: Match each phrasal verb with its definition.
questions.explanation: 1) look after — Look after означає доглядати за людиною або твариною. Відповідний фрагмент: Take responsibility for someone's care and well-being. 2) get along with — Get along with означає добре ладнати. Відповідний фрагмент: Have a friendly relationship with another person. 3) make up — Make up у контексті конфлікту — помиритися. Відповідний фрагмент: Become friendly again after an argument. 4) put off — Put off означає перенести на пізніше. Відповідний фрагмент: Delay an activity until a later date.

pairs: look after
Take responsibility for someone's care and well-being.
get along with
Have a friendly relationship with another person.
make up
Become friendly again after an argument.
put off
Delay an activity until a later date.

questions.text: Match the headings with the paragraphs about changes at home.
questions.explanation: 1) A quieter place to study — Наголос на новому робочому місці та зменшенні відволікань. Відповідний фрагмент: Sofia moved her desk into a spare room. With fewer interruptions, she finishes assignments more efficiently. 2) Learning from older relatives — Основна ідея — досвід, що передається між поколіннями. Відповідний фрагмент: Once a week, Max visits his grandfather, who teaches him traditional recipes. Their conversations also help him understand family history. 3) Adapting to a new neighbourhood — Текст про соціальне пристосування після переїзду. Відповідний фрагмент: At first, the family knew nobody on their street. Joining a local club helped them meet people and feel more comfortable. 4) An unexpected change of plans — Замість запланованої події родина знайшла інший варіант. Відповідний фрагмент: The picnic was cancelled when the weather suddenly worsened. Instead, everyone gathered indoors for board games.

pairs: A quieter place to study
Sofia moved her desk into a spare room. With fewer interruptions, she finishes assignments more efficiently.
Learning from older relatives
Once a week, Max visits his grandfather, who teaches him traditional recipes. Their conversations also help him understand family history.
Adapting to a new neighbourhood
At first, the family knew nobody on their street. Joining a local club helped them meet people and feel more comfortable.
An unexpected change of plans
The picnic was cancelled when the weather suddenly worsened. Instead, everyone gathered indoors for board games.

questions.text: Match each social phrase with the situation in which it is appropriate.
questions.explanation: 1) I appreciate your help, but I can manage from here. — Ввічлива відмова з подякою та без грубості. Відповідний фрагмент: You are politely declining further assistance after receiving support. 2) Would you mind lowering the volume a little? — Would you mind — непряме ввічливе прохання. Відповідний фрагмент: You need to make a respectful request to someone nearby. 3) I'm sorry I overlooked your message. — Apologise за пропущене повідомлення. Відповідний фрагмент: You are acknowledging that you failed to reply earlier. 4) That's a fair point; I hadn't considered it. — Вислів визнає аргумент співрозмовника. Відповідний фрагмент: You recognise the value of an opinion that differs from yours.

pairs: I appreciate your help, but I can manage from here.
You are politely declining further assistance after receiving support.
Would you mind lowering the volume a little?
You need to make a respectful request to someone nearby.
I'm sorry I overlooked your message.
You are acknowledging that you failed to reply earlier.
That's a fair point; I hadn't considered it.
You recognise the value of an opinion that differs from yours.

questions.text: Match each heading with the implied message of the paragraph.
questions.explanation: 1) Respecting personal boundaries — У тексті про право відмовитися та повагу до особистих меж. Відповідний фрагмент: When her friends suggested another event, Maya explained that she needed an evening alone. They accepted her decision without pressuring her to attend. 2) Managing expectations — Реалістичні очікування й поступові цілі. Відповідний фрагмент: The coach explained that improvement would take several weeks. The team therefore set small weekly goals instead of expecting immediate results. 3) Resolving a misunderstanding — Конфлікт виявився наслідком помилки в комунікації. Відповідний фрагмент: Omar thought his colleague had ignored his request. After a short conversation, he discovered that the email had gone to the wrong address. 4) Valuing different perspectives — Компроміс виник через увагу до різних поглядів. Відповідний фрагмент: The neighbours initially disagreed about how to use the shared garden. Listening to one another led to a plan that included both vegetables and flowers.

pairs: Respecting personal boundaries
When her friends suggested another event, Maya explained that she needed an evening alone. They accepted her decision without pressuring her to attend.
Managing expectations
The coach explained that improvement would take several weeks. The team therefore set small weekly goals instead of expecting immediate results.
Resolving a misunderstanding
Omar thought his colleague had ignored his request. After a short conversation, he discovered that the email had gone to the wrong address.
Valuing different perspectives
The neighbours initially disagreed about how to use the shared garden. Listening to one another led to a plan that included both vegetables and flowers.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: laundry, breakfast, tidy. Every Saturday, Mia prepares (1)___ for her younger brother. Then she helps with the (2)___, putting the clothes into the washing machine. Before lunch, they (3)___ their shared room.
questions.explanation: (1) breakfast — Prepare breakfast — готувати ранкову їжу. (2) laundry — Do/help with the laundry стосується прання. (3) tidy — Tidy a room — прибирати приміщення.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: neighbour, entrance, parcel. Our (1)___ knocked on the door this afternoon. A delivery driver had left a (2)___ for us while we were out. We thanked her and carried it inside through the main (3)___.
questions.explanation: (1) neighbour — Людина, що живе поруч, — neighbour. (2) parcel — Посилка від служби доставки — parcel. (3) entrance — Main entrance — головний вхід.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: invitation, celebrate, guests. We received an (1)___ to my aunt's birthday party. She is planning to (2)___ at home this year. About twenty (3)___ are expected to arrive on Sunday.
questions.explanation: (1) invitation — Invitation означає запрошення на подію. (2) celebrate — Celebrate — святкувати нагоду. (3) guests — Guests — люди, запрошені на свято.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: chores, commute, flexible. My father's working hours are (1)___, so he sometimes starts after lunch. His daily (2)___ takes only fifteen minutes by bicycle. In the evening, everyone shares the household (3)___ to save time.
questions.explanation: (1) flexible — Flexible hours — гнучкий графік. (2) commute — Commute — регулярна дорога між домом і роботою. (3) chores — Household chores — домашні обов'язки.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: considerate, conflict, compromise. Two flatmates had a (1)___ about late-night music. Rather than blaming each other, they agreed on a (2)___ about quiet hours. Both tried to be more (3)___ of the other's need for sleep.
questions.explanation: (1) conflict — Conflict — зіткнення інтересів або суперечка. (2) compromise — Compromise — взаємна поступка для розв'язання проблеми. (3) considerate — Considerate of — уважний до потреб іншої людини.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: confidential, reassurance, trustworthy, boundaries. The youth adviser explained that personal information would remain (1)___. That promise gave the students (2)___ before the meeting began. They regarded the adviser as (3)___ because she never broke their confidence. The group also agreed to respect everyone's (4)___ during discussions.
questions.explanation: (1) confidential — Confidential означає таку інформацію, яку не розголошують. (2) reassurance — Reassurance — слова або дії, що заспокоюють і додають упевненості. (3) trustworthy — Trustworthy означає надійну особу, якій можна довіряти. (4) boundaries — Personal boundaries — особисті межі людини.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: overlooked, misunderstanding, clarify, apologised. I had (1)___ an important detail in my friend's message. This led to a (2)___ about the meeting time. I called to (3)___ what had happened. Afterwards, I (4)___ for the confusion.
questions.explanation: (1) overlooked — Overlook означає ненавмисно не помітити деталь. (2) misunderstanding — Misunderstanding — непорозуміння через неправильне тлумачення. (3) clarify — Clarify означає зробити інформацію зрозумілою. (4) apologised — Apologised — вибачився за спричинену плутанину.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: reluctant, initiative, overwhelmed, delegate. Our class captain felt (1)___ by the number of tasks before the charity fair. At first, she was (2)___ to ask for help, believing she should manage alone. Her teacher encouraged her to (3)___ some responsibilities. Other students then took the (4)___ and organised the stalls.
questions.explanation: (1) overwhelmed — Overwhelmed — перевантажений великою кількістю справ. (2) reluctant — Reluctant to — неохочий, який вагається щось робити. (3) delegate — Delegate responsibilities означає передавати завдання іншим. (4) initiative — Take the initiative — проявити ініціативу.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: mutual, resentment, acknowledge, reconcile. After months of disagreement, the cousins wanted to (1)___. First, each agreed to (2)___ their own mistakes. This helped reduce the (3)___ that had built up over time. They decided that future decisions should be based on (4)___ respect.
questions.explanation: (1) reconcile — Reconcile — відновити добрі взаємини після конфлікту. (2) acknowledge — Acknowledge mistakes — визнавати власні помилки. (3) resentment — Resentment — прихована образа чи накопичене обурення. (4) mutual — Mutual respect — взаємна повага.

questions.text: Complete the passage using each word from the box once: tactful, intrusive, rapport, disclose. The interviewer avoided (1)___ questions about the candidate's private life. Instead, she made a (2)___ comment to put the visitor at ease. This helped establish (3)___ between them. As a result, the candidate felt comfortable enough to (4)___ relevant information about previous work.
questions.explanation: (1) intrusive — Intrusive questions — надмірно особисті, нав'язливі питання. (2) tactful — Tactful — делікатний, тактовний. (3) rapport — Rapport означає взаєморозуміння та контакт між людьми. (4) disclose — Disclose — відкрито повідомити раніше неозвучені відомості.
